subject: Next steps: procurement path & marketplace readiness for AuroraCorp
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@auroracorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & quick procurement checklist (AuroraCorp / Redwood)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have aligned next steps for procurement and commercial path: 

- Primary buying org: AuroraCorp CloudOps (Elena). Procurement will formally sign (procurement@auroracorp.com).
- Preferred payment route: Elena mentioned preference for consolidated billing; team is evaluating AWS Marketplace first, fallback to PO invoicing if Marketplace isn’t approved.
- Procurement timeline: internal procurement review ~2–3 weeks after we deliver SOW/sample contract and marketplace info.
- Technical POC: small test environment (2–4k tokens/day) to verify latency and KV caching; target start week of Nov 15.
- Contract needs: MSA + SOW; minimal privacy addendum (we can provide template).

Action items we committed to: 
1) I’ll share a short procurement checklist for Marketplace vs PO routes (attached).
2) Vivek will add a short note on marketplace technical requirements (AMI/entitlement flow) for your cloudops team.
3) Marissa will prep a sample SOW and estimate for a 3-month POC.
4) Elena / Procurement: confirm whether AuroraCorp prefers AWS Marketplace or direct PO (reply with point of contact for procurement).

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW), procurement-checklist.xlsx (marketplace vs PO checklist).

If helpful, we can also provide Marketplace listing draft copy (listing SKU + entitlements) so procurement can run internal vendor onboarding in parallel.

Thanks again — aim to reconvene after you loop procurement.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123
redwood.ai

From: Elena Park <elena.park@auroracorp.com>

Date: 2026-11-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & quick procurement checklist (AuroraCorp / Redwood)

Hi Tessa —

Appreciate the clear notes. Quick answers from my side: 
- We are inclined toward AWS Marketplace to keep billing consolidated, but procurement will need the Seller listing info (SKU, pricing model, T&Cs) to confirm.
- Procurement contact: same mailbox (procurement@auroracorp.com). I cc’d them here. They will likely ask for SOC2 evidence and our legal will review the MSA.
- Timeline: procurement said they could start the intake the week of Nov 8 and likely take 10–15 business days.
- POC: confirmed — CloudOps can spin up the small test environment Nov 15–22. We need a short runbook for credentials/entitlements if using AWS Marketplace (entitlement-based SaaS preferred).

Procurement note: feel free to drop the procurement checklist into our vendor intake form (procurement@auroracorp.com will confirm required docs).

Thanks — I’ll expect the SOW and the listing draft.

Best,
Elena
Sr. Cloud Engineering Manager, AuroraCorp

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & quick procurement checklist (AuroraCorp / Redwood)

Hi Elena + Procurement team —

Thanks for looping procurement in. A couple of quick technical clarifications from our side that help speed marketplace onboarding vs PO: 

- Marketplace (AWS) entitlements flow: we can support both SaaS subscription and usage-based SKUs. For POC we recommend an entitlement SKU + short-term usage SKU so CloudOps can test without creating separate infra.
- Required evidence: we’ll attach our SOC 2 Type II report and data handling summary (redacted) in the vendor intake packet.
- Networking: if Aurora wants VPC endpoints or private link access for the POC, we can provide a config checklist; otherwise standard internet egress is fine for the small test.
- Billing & invoicing: Marketplace will surface on Aurora’s consolidated billing; if procurement prefers a PO, we can accept net-30 invoices under an MSA.

Proposed next steps (short timeline):
1) Tessa to upload SOW + listing draft to procurement intake (today).
2) Marissa to publish a compact POC runbook (credentials/entitlement steps) by EOD tomorrow.
3) Redwood to send SOC2 link and vendor packet to procurement (by Nov 4).

If procurement has specific vendor intake URLs or portal IDs please share them and we’ll upload directly.

Thanks — Vivek
Director, Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@auroracorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & quick procurement checklist (AuroraCorp / Redwood)

Hi Tessa / Vivek / Marissa —

Thanks for the materials. A couple of items procurement will need to proceed with AWS Marketplace intake (please confirm and provide where noted):

1) Marketplace SKU draft and short description (one paragraph) — required for vendor catalog.
2) SOC2 Type II public link and data retention policy (PDF).
3) W-9 (for tax) and standard vendor onboarding form — we will send a DocuSign request if the above looks good.
4) Standard MSA with Redwood’s signature block for Aurora (we prefer MSA followed by SOW).
5) Estimated annual spend band for quoting (we can accept a range for the intake form).

Procurement timeline: after we receive the materials, intake begins and we’ll target approval/marketplace enrollment in ~10 business days, assuming no legal redlines.

Please upload the items here: https://procurement.auroracorp.com/vendor-intake/AC-2981 (secure portal).

Attached: vendor-onboarding-form.pdf (placeholder) — please confirm W-9 route.

Let us know if you want a short intake call with procurement tomorrow at 11am PT.

Thanks,
AuroraCorp Procurement
